newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil slightly firmer, futures unchanged.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil slightly firmer, futures unchanged.

text.p: NWE gas oil was a touch firmer on Monday with some premiums showing a stronger tone and futures unchanged. The market has almost finished with March.
April IPE gas oil closed unchanged at $170.75.
Heating oil barge premiums were seen a touch firmer as the market looked for April material.
"March is pretty much done and if you want prompt barrels it is costing more," said one barge trader.
Second half March was talked around April IPE -$1 to -75 cents, a gain since Friday of about 50 cents. April barrels were also about 50 cents stronger but there was very little interest.
Diesel barge premiums were also marginally higher with Rotterdam refinery -3,-13 material heard offered at April IPE +$14 fob ARA.
DIN cargoes continued to be supported from buying interest of April IPE +$5 cif Germany for April 1-10 dates. An offer of April IPE +$4 cif Hamburg was also heard.
Some traders said the potential buyer was trying to keep the market strong, possibly to cover swaps positions, while other players said +$5 was fair level for the option to take into Bremen.
